open_function_group.name: Z stepper motor and connector
open_function_group.source_line: - He reports that the printer-posted supply wiring had reversed polarity: the power-supply indicator did not illuminate while connected to the board, then lit after he unplugged it. He says he checked the wires with a multimeter and verified the polarity was reversed. This is a reported incident, not a universal connector pin assignment.
